{{Quote|That is no mere tree. It is the place of Ascension. For 4,000 years, it has been the source of my people's great magic.|Chief Okko|<ref name="DEII audio" />}}
The '''ritual of ascent''' was a ceremony performed by the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] tribe of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. In the belief that an [[Ood Bnar|ancient tree]] known as the "place of Ascension" was the source of [[The Force/Legends|Ysanna magic]], the ritual saw the individual tied at the place of ascension to imbue them with magic.<ref name="DEII audio" />
